verdict.rationale: Dagster's own code-first framework lets you write a custom ETL asset in Python, scaffold Component definitions with `dg scaffold defs`, and wrap dlt sources as assets. So a long-tail API can be ingested without forking anything, but there is no dedicated connector SDK or low-code builder. Missing for 10: a purpose-built connector SDK or low-code connector builder, documentation specific to authoring API connectors (auth, pagination, incremental state), and hands-on corroboration of building a long-tail connector.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I build a custom connector for a long-tail API with a supported framework or low-code builder, not a fork

citations.quote: Creating a single Dagster asset that encapsulates the entire Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) process
You can scaffold Dagster Component definitions in your project from the command line with the `dg scaffold defs` command
The dagster-dlt library provides a DltLoadCollectionComponent which can be used to easily represent a collection of dlt sources and pipelines as assets in Dagster.
